title: Changes in Existing Decommissioning, Restoration and Similar Liabilities
summary: Addresses the accounting for changes in existing decommissioning, restoration and similar liabilities that are included as part of the cost of property, plant and equipment under IAS 16.

related.title: Property, Plant and Equipment
related.relationship: Governs initial capitalisation of the obligation and depreciation of the resulting asset cost

related.title: Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets
related.relationship: Governs recognition and measurement of the underlying provision

related.title: Impairment of Assets
related.relationship: Impairment testing may be triggered by an upward asset-cost adjustment

related.title: Leases
related.relationship: Restoration obligations linked to leased assets follow analogous logic
